description: Plan CapCut-style punch-in zoom keyframes (Motion Scale + subject-anchored Position) from a word timeline or supplied trigger times, with cooldown, easing, and hold controls. Local-only and deterministic; returns a keyframe plan for automate_effect_parameters_uxp or add_keyframe and never changes Premiere.

alternate.description: When true, triggers alternate between a punch-in that stays zoomed and a punch-out back to base instead of every trigger zooming and returning.

base_scale.description: Resting Motion Scale percent; defaults to 100.

clip_start_seconds.description: Timeline offset of the clip; added to produce timeline_seconds on every keyframe. Defaults to 0.

cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum spacing between accepted triggers; closer triggers are dropped with a warning. Defaults to 2.5.

ease_in_frames.description: Frames to ramp from base to zoom (0 = instant cut zoom); defaults to 3.

ease_out_frames.description: Frames to ramp back to base (0 = instant); defaults to 6.

emphasis_words.description: Words or short phrases that trigger a zoom in emphasis_words mode (case and punctuation insensitive).

every_n_seconds.description: Trigger interval for every_n_seconds mode, measured from the start of the word timeline.

frame.description: Sequence frame size in pixels; defaults to 1080x1920.

frame_rate.description: Sequence frame rate used to snap keyframe times; defaults to 30.

hold_seconds.description: Seconds to hold the zoomed scale before easing out; defaults to 1.2.

max_zooms.description: Maximum accepted zoom events; defaults to 120.

subject_point.description: Normalized (0..1) subject location the zoom should stay anchored on; defaults to x 0.5, y 0.4 for talking heads.

trigger.description: Trigger mode. Defaults to sentence_start with word_timeline and supplied with trigger_seconds.

trigger_seconds.description: Clip-relative trigger times in seconds; use instead of word_timeline (exactly one is required).

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

zoom_scale.description: Peak Motion Scale percent for each punch-in; defaults to 112 and must exceed base_scale.

name: plan_emphasis_zoom_keyframes

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Emphasis Zoom Keyframes
